notes: GL data of a company (journals, accounts, cost centres 1/2, estimate periods) from which the groups are granted; derived level / end position, all-of-a-kind buttons (APP_RULES3_SE, see processes/ACCOMPANY_ACCOUNT.md)

AC_COMPANY_ENTRY.ENTRY_TYPE.lov: select entry_type || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(entry_desc_e, entry_desc) else entry_desc end || ' (' || decode(serial_flag, 0, 'مسلسل سنوي', 1, 'مسلسل شهري') || ')' d, entry_type r from ac_trn_codes where entry_year = :PAGE_ENTRY_YEAR order by entry_type

params.name: KIND
params.lov_sql: select case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then e else a end d, r from (select 'جميع الحركات' a, 'All journals' e, 'ENTRY' r, 1 s from dual union all select 'جميع الحسابات', 'All accounts', 'MASTER', 2 from dual union all select 'مركز التكلفة 1', 'Cost centre 1', 'COST1', 3 from dual union all select 'مركز التكلفة 2', 'Cost centre 2', 'COST2', 4 from dual union all select 'فترات تقديريه', 'Estimate periods', 'PERIOD', 5 from dual) order by s
